title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - SoftwareResource
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/SoftwareResource. A Gaia-X Virtual Resource describing an executable program. Subclass of VirtualResource per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the VirtualResource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SoftwareResource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

checkSum.description: Relationship. Details on checksum of the software. Links to a CheckSum entity.

signature.description: Relationship. Details with respect to signature of the software. Links to a Signature entity.

patchLevel.description: Property. Software-specific patch number describing patch level of the software.

buildDate.description: Property. Date and time the software was built, formatted according to ISO 8601 (UTC).
